product_metadata.title: DISSA Sherpa Blanket Fleece Throw – 51x63, White Green – Soft, Plush, Fluffy, Fuzzy, Warm, Cozy, Thick – Perfect for Couch, Bed, Sofa, Chair - Reversible Throw Blanket
features: 【Cozy & Warm】- Get cozy and lightweight with this extremely soft and fuzzy blanket. Whether you want to use it in a air condition area or winter use, the throw blanket will provide warmth and excellent experience. Great for indoor or outdoor use.
【Blanket Size】- 51 x 63 inches, perfect size for couch, Sofa Chair. Great for relaxing ,snuggling, watching TV, reading, or cuddling.

【Stripe Design】- Sherpa and flannel double Sided design one side is super soft sherpa fleece which is cozy and warm. The other side is flannel, different color and white stripe pattern with 3D touching offers you amazing senses of softness.
【Gift Choice】- This beautiful classical and fashion blanket is designed for luxurious feel and elegance, its made of high grade sherpa , perfect for personal gift in any occasion.
【Machine Wash】- Machine wash on gentle cycle with cold water,tumble dry at very low temperature, holds several machine wash and dry beautifully.
